# package client

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-knx/client"
```

Package client is KNX group communication over a link: a KNXnet/IP tunnel (package tunnel) or routing (package routing). It writes, reads and answers group values, typed with datapoint types (package dpt) or raw, and delivers the group telegrams it sees to subscriptions and callbacks.

	c, err := client.DialTunnel(ctx, "192.168.1.10")
	if err != nil { ... }
	defer c.Close()
	err = c.GroupWrite(ctx, knx.MustParseGroupAddress("1/2/3"), true)
	r, err := c.GroupRead(ctx, knx.MustParseGroupAddress("1/2/4"), client.WithDPT("9.001"))

A group read is a request on the bus: no response is guaranteed (no device may have the R flag for that address), and several devices may answer. GroupRead returns the first response within the deadline; GroupReadAll collects all of them during a window.

## Constants

```go
const DefaultMaxResponses = 1000
```

DefaultMaxResponses is the number of responses GroupReadAll keeps unless WithMaxResponses sets another.

```go
const DefaultReadTimeout = 3 * time.Second
```

DefaultReadTimeout bounds GroupRead when the context has no deadline.

```go
const MaxPropertyData = 250
```

MaxPropertyData is the most property data PropertyWrite sends: the TPDU of an A\_PropertyValue\_Write (2 octets of TPCI and APCI, 4 of object, property, count and start, then the data) fits a cEMI NPDU of 255 octets. Secured access (tool key) adds Data Secure octets, so a smaller write can still be refused with knx.ErrInvalidValue at send.

#### func (Client) GroupRead

```go
func (c *Client) GroupRead(ctx context.Context, g knx.GroupAddress, opts ...WriteOption) (Response, error)
```

GroupRead sends A\_GroupValue\_Read to g and returns the first A\_GroupValue\_Response to g before ctx's deadline (DefaultReadTimeout without one). It returns an error matching knx.ErrTimeout when no device answered. With WithDPT the value is decoded too.

#### func (Client) GroupReadAll

```go
func (c *Client) GroupReadAll(ctx context.Context, g knx.GroupAddress, window time.Duration, opts ...WriteOption) ([]Response, error)
```

GroupReadAll sends A\_GroupValue\_Read to g and returns every response to g received during window (possibly none), up to WithMaxResponses (DefaultMaxResponses): it returns early once it has that many.

#### func (Client) GroupRespond

```go
func (c *Client) GroupRespond(ctx context.Context, g knx.GroupAddress, v any, opts ...WriteOption) error
```

GroupRespond sends A\_GroupValue\_Response of v to g.

#### func (Client) GroupWrite

```go
func (c *Client) GroupWrite(ctx context.Context, g knx.GroupAddress, v any, opts ...WriteOption) error
```

GroupWrite sends A\_GroupValue\_Write of v to g. v is a bool (DPT 1), an apdu.GroupValue or \[]byte (raw), or any value of the type set by WithDPT. Over a tunnel it returns once the server confirmed the telegram (L\_Data.con).

#### func (Client) OnTelegram


OnTelegram calls f, from the client's reader goroutine, for every group telegram; it must not block. The returned function removes it.

Device is the remote management of one device, its individual address, through the client's link: property values and descriptions and the device descriptor. Requests are sent one at a time. Close it to end its transport connection.

#### func (Device) PropertyDescription

```go
func (d *Device) PropertyDescription(ctx context.Context, object, pid, index uint8) (mgmt.Description, error)
```

PropertyDescription reads the description of property pid of the interface object at index object: its datatype, whether it is writable, its maximum number of elements and its access levels. With pid 0 the property is named by index, its position in the object. A negative answer (no such object or property) returns a \*mgmt.PropertyError.

#### func (Device) PropertyElements


PropertyElements returns the number of elements of a property.

#### func (Device) PropertyRead

```go
func (d *Device) PropertyRead(ctx context.Context, object, pid uint8, start uint16, count uint8) ([]byte, error)
```

PropertyRead reads count elements (1..15) of property pid of the interface object at index object from element start (1-based; start 0 reads the number of elements).

#### func (Device) PropertyWrite

```go
func (d *Device) PropertyWrite(ctx context.Context, object, pid uint8, start uint16, count uint8, data []byte) ([]byte, error)
```

PropertyWrite writes count elements of a property from element start and returns the value the device answers with (the elements after the write).


#### func Connected

Connected accesses the device in a transport layer connection (T\_Connect, numbered and acknowledged data, T\_Disconnect) instead of connectionless.

#### func WithToolKey

```go
func WithToolKey(k datasecure.Key) DeviceOption
```

WithToolKey secures the access with the device's tool key (KNX Data Secure point to point with tool access): an S-A\_Sync before the first request, then S-A\_Data. Without this option the access is secured when the client's Data Secure table (WithDataSecure) has the device's tool key.

### type Option

#### func WithDataSecure

```go
func WithDataSecure(t *datasecure.Table) Option
```

WithDataSecure secures the group communication with KNX Data Secure: telegrams to the table's secured groups are sent as S-A\_Data, received ones are verified and decrypted, and plain or failing telegrams to those groups are dropped. The source address is part of the MAC, so telegrams are sent with the client's source (WithSource) or else the link's individual address.

#### func WithMaxResponses

```go

```

WithMaxResponses sets how many responses GroupReadAll keeps (1 or more; DefaultMaxResponses without it). GroupReadAll returns as soon as it has that many: a flood of responses does not grow memory.
